units.source_text: 他忍无可忍，竟从他靠身的柱子旁边的帘子底下探身进去，拉住了二女公子的衣袖。

en.t: Unable to restrain himself any longer, he reached in beneath the curtain beside the pillar where he had been leaning and caught hold of the Second Princess's sleeve.

units.source_text: 二女公子想道：“原来他不怀好意，真讨厌！”

en.t: The Second Princess thought, So he did have improper intentions after all. How hateful!

units.source_text: 她无话可说，只是默默地向后倒退。

en.t: She had no words to answer him and only drew back in silence.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言紧跟着她，顺水推舟地把半个身子攒进帘内，

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, followed close after her and, taking advantage of the moment, pushed half his body inside the curtain,

units.source_text: 就在她身边躺下了，说道：“不知我是否记错：

en.t: then lay down beside her and said, I wonder whether I remember wrongly:

units.source_text: 小姐曾对我说过‘没人看见是无妨的’。

en.t: you once told me that it would not matter if no one saw us.

units.source_text: 不知我是否听错，所以进来问问。

en.t: I wondered whether I had misheard, so I came in to ask.

units.source_text: 请你不要疏远我！

en.t: Please do not keep me at a distance.

units.source_text: 你这态度多么无情啊！”

en.t: How heartless this attitude of yours is!

units.source_text: 说时不胜怨恨之情。

en.t: As he spoke, he could not suppress the resentment in his voice.

units.source_text: 二女公子无心回答，但觉荒唐可恶，气得发昏。

en.t: The Second Princess had no wish to reply; she found it so absurd and hateful that she was dizzy with anger.

units.source_text: 终于镇静下来，说道：“你的用心真乃出人意外！

en.t: At last she calmed herself and said, Your intentions are truly beyond anything I expected!

units.source_text: 侍女们看见了成什么样子呢！

en.t: What would it look like if the ladies-in-waiting saw this?

units.source_text: 太无礼了！”

en.t: This is far too rude!

units.source_text: 她辱骂他，几乎想哭出来。

en.t: She reproached him sharply and was almost ready to burst into tears.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言觉得这话也有几分道理，心中颇感抱歉。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, felt that there was some truth in her words and was rather sorry in his heart.

units.source_text: 然而还是强辩：“我这行为不会受人非难。

en.t: Even so, he still argued stubbornly, No one could criticize me for this behavior.

units.source_text: 当年曾有一夜和你如此对晤，你总还记得吧。

en.t: Surely you remember that once, years ago, I spent a night speaking with you in just this way.

units.source_text: 你姐姐也曾允许我亲近你。

en.t: Your elder sister also once permitted me to be close to you.

units.source_text: 你以为我无礼，反而不知趣了。

en.t: If you think me rude, then it is you who misunderstand the situation.

units.source_text: 我决没有色情的野心，请你放心可也。”

en.t: I have no lustful ambition at all, so please be at ease.

units.source_text: 他说时态度从容不迫。

en.t: He spoke with a calm and unhurried manner.

units.source_text: 但因近来常常追悔前事，苦痛越来越深，

en.t: But lately he had often regretted what had happened before, and his suffering had only grown deeper,

units.source_text: 便把心事叨叨絮絮地向二女公子诉说，全无准备离去的样子。

en.t: so he poured out his feelings to the Second Princess at length, with no sign at all that he meant to leave.

units.source_text: 二女公子毫无办法，此时她的心情，狼狈两字已经不够形容了！

en.t: The Second Princess had no way to deal with him; at that moment, mere embarrassment was no longer enough to describe her state of mind.

units.source_text: 她觉得对付此人，比对付全不相识的人更加可耻可恨，只有吞声饮泣。

en.t: She felt that facing this man was even more shameful and hateful than facing a total stranger, and could only choke back her sobs.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言对她说道：“你何必如此呢？

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, said to her, Why must you be like this?

units.source_text: 太孩子气了。”

en.t: It is far too childish.

units.source_text: 他看看二女公子，但觉说不出的可怜可爱。

en.t: As he looked at the Second Princess, he found her pitiful and lovely beyond words.

units.source_text: 而她那含蓄优雅之神态，比那年夜间所见更加圆满成熟。

en.t: Her restrained and graceful bearing seemed even fuller and more mature than what he had seen that night years before.

units.source_text: 想起了从前自动把此人让与他人，以致今日如此颠倒梦想，后悔不已，

en.t: Remembering that he had once given her up to someone else of his own accord, and that this had brought him to such confused longing today, he was filled with endless regret,

units.source_text: 竟嘘嘘唏唏地哭了起来。

en.t: and at last he began to sob aloud.

units.source_text: 二女公子身边只有两个侍女。

en.t: There were only two attendants by the Second Princess's side.

units.source_text: 她们望见一个素不相识的男子攒进帘内来，不知有何事情，

en.t: When they saw a man they did not know pushing inside the curtain, they wondered what was happening,

units.source_text: 连忙走近来看。

en.t: and hurried closer to look.

units.source_text: 看见这男子是薰中纳言，知道他是一向关怀亲切的熟客人，

en.t: When they saw that the man was Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, and knew him as a familiar visitor who had always shown kind concern,

units.source_text: 料想今日或有缘故。

en.t: they supposed there must be some reason for his visit today.

units.source_text: 她们觉得不好意思留在近旁，便装作不知，退出外边去。

en.t: Feeling awkward about staying nearby, they pretended not to notice and withdrew outside.

units.source_text: 二女公子更觉孤寂了。

en.t: The Second Princess felt even more alone.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言深悔当年失策，苦痛难于忍受，心情一时不易镇静。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, deeply regretted his mistake of years before, and his pain was so hard to bear that his heart could not soon grow calm.

units.source_text: 然而从前对晤一夜，尚且规规矩矩，一心不乱。

en.t: Yet even when he had once spent a night facing her in conversation, he had behaved properly and kept his mind composed.

units.source_text: 今日当然不会胡作非为。

en.t: Of course he would not act recklessly today either.

units.source_text: 但此种事情，不须详细叙述了。

en.t: But there is no need to describe such matters in detail.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言懊恨此行徒然无益，而外人看了又不成样。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, bitterly regretted that this visit had been useless, and that it would look improper to outsiders as well.

units.source_text: 左思右想了一会，终于告辞而出。

en.t: After thinking it over from every side for a while, he finally took his leave and went out.
